scientific_integrity.earliest_referenced_lead_publication: 2020-06-12 arXiv version of Mészáros paper, primary MSC2020 60C05. Earlier historical work is acknowledged as background rather than the lead publication.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No extension asserted to random-vertex greedy sampling, weighted edges, other graph families, or all maximal-matching measures. Historical priority uncertain because a 1991 fixed-graph greedy-matching article could not be inspected in full.
scientific_integrity.principal_statement: For the random feasible-edge greedy matching on a crown graph with n labels per side, the probability of a nonperfect output is 2/n+O(log(n)/n^2), whereas a uniformly chosen maximal matching is nonperfect with probability tending to 1/2.
scientific_integrity.proof_integrity: Self-contained exact state recursion and moment bounds establish all infinite-size inequalities; the standalone exact checker is supporting finite evidence, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_integrity.scope: Deterministic simple unweighted complete bipartite graph with the identity matching removed; random-edge greedy algorithm, integer n at least three.

title: Sharp greedy-matching deficit on crown graphs
